call_main_distributed: call main entry point with automatic distributed training setup across multiple GPUs or TPU cores
distributed_init_process_group: initialize the distributed process group with NCCL backend and rank configuration for multi-GPU training
all_gather_list_pickled_data: gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all workers into a single list across the process group
all_reduce_dict_tensors: all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across workers, separating CPU and device data for performance
infer_init_method_slurm: infer the distributed init method from SLURM environment variables or fall back to localhost for multi-GPU
